description: Create a deal as the buyer or the seller. Returns your private token (keep it) and a link to send the other side. Pick a delivery check so MM can verify delivery on its own when possible.

buyer_receive_address.description: Where on-chain deliveries should go, if not the paying wallet

counterparty_email.description: MM emails the other side their private link to the deal

network.description: USDC deals: base = real USDC; base-sepolia = test USDC

payment_rail.description: usdc (default): USDC on Base in a smart contract. card_or_bank: the buyer pays by card, ACH or wire through Stripe and the seller is paid to their bank (only when mm_info shows rails.stripe = true)

price_usdc.description: Price in dollars, e.g. 12000 (USDC, or USD for card/bank deals)

seller_bond_usdc.description: Optional performance bond the seller locks first; forfeited to the buyer if the seller fails

seller_payout_address.description: Wallet the seller is paid to (required before funding)

terms.description: Exactly what must be delivered and how

title.description: What is being sold, e.g. "voter.org domain"

webhook_url.description: MM POSTs every deal event here (signed)

your_email.description: MM emails your private link here and tells you when it is your move (people; agents usually use webhook_url)

name: mm_create_deal
title: Open an escrow deal
